learner_operation: Normalize the ODE; identify p,q,n; divide by y^n and use z=y^(1-n); solve the linear equation with an integrating factor; recover the nonzero real family and select its equation.

fixed_features.feature: Bernoulli exponent and coefficient function types within each source profile
fixed_features.justification: These fix the substitution, real inverse and elementary integration technique; see tutorial 238cafad-c43b-5970-af70-5ce0cab5442c and instructional-account.md.

fixed_features.feature: One five-choice radio field, exactly one key
fixed_features.justification: Every complete captured practice bank uses this response contract. A fixed correct-choice count is intrinsic to radio selection.

fixed_features.feature: Hard profiles require normalization before substitution
fixed_features.justification: Retains the observed distinction between moderate standard-form prompts and hard nonstandard equations.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: All five neighboring-equation formulas can qualify with the bank held fixed. The selected coefficient pair changes the displayed ODE, key and worked solution.
answer_roles.observed: All five roles verified independently in all ten profiles, before and after shared delivery filtering.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: a has three positive values; b has six signed nonzero values. These change homogeneous and particular terms without adding integration methods.
answer_roles.observed: The controlled/boundary tests cover every a value and every b value in every profile. Autonomous q-109029 is selected 4/24 times in the small ordinary sample.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: Author order and actual UI order vary independently of the fixed source position.
answer_roles.observed: Controlled authored keys have multiple positions per profile. Seven actual UI previews cover positions 1 through 5.

coverage.result: 10 complete banks, 50/50 choices, original keys and worked stages matched after TeX sizing normalization. q-106074 remains a documented incomplete erroneous bank.

Every option qualifies in turn within each of 10 fixed banks; all 50 assignments survive actual delivery filtering. Seven coefficient-defined semantic equations per profile, ignoring seeds, UUIDs, banks and coordinate shifts.
24 ordinary moderate records plus a five-record CLI batch. Final batch has five accepted records and no duplicates. All six complete moderate families remain eligible in ordinary generation.
All one captured generated member reproduced and affected. Eleven original source questions are not relabeled generated.

counterfactuals.change: Change selected (a,b) within one fixed bank, holding profile and coordinate shift fixed
counterfactuals.expected: Each formula can be the correct solution; prompt and worked stages must change and the previous choice must be rejected under its new field-owned identity.
counterfactuals.observed: All 50 controlled records have the unique independently residual-verified key; complete native grader banks pass. All five assignments per profile survive delivery.
counterfactuals.justification: The selected equation coefficients determine the integrating factor and particular integral, not the visible bank identity.

counterfactuals.expected: The particular term changes; the original solution is no longer valid for the changed equation.
counterfactuals.observed: Both formerly rejected API coefficient cases now generate and pass independent math/native checks. Fixed-bank target 0->1 is the corresponding same-bank b=1->2 change; rendered previews 2 and 3 show the changed equation and answer.
counterfactuals.justification: Multiplying q by 2 preserves the Bernoulli substitution and power-rule integration workload.

counterfactuals.change: Seed 98301 -> 73429 with the entire q-109154 instance fixed
counterfactuals.expected: Question, choice values and key unchanged
counterfactuals.observed: Entire question object is equal, including the worked solution and field-owned identities.
counterfactuals.justification: Seed is generation metadata once all mathematical and bank parameters are specified.

delivery_stages.generator: Every eligible coefficient pair has a nonresonant elementary integral; production samples five distinct pairs and independently chooses one target. There is no math rejection loop that removes role cases. CLI resamples duplicate full instances, up to 1000 seed attempts.
delivery_stages.shared_filter: check_delivery.py exercised on moderate, hard and the final five-record batch using supplied source and captured inventory. All controlled assignments survive.
delivery_stages.learner_selection: Read-only Rust selection model with explicit synthetic entity IDs confirms all five role cases have positive draw support in a positive-weight band before history exclusions. Actual histories and weights are unavailable; no prediction of future selected tasks is claimed.

limitations: Source q-106074 lacks a captured key/solution and has no mathematically valid supplied choice; it remains unresolved. No easy source supports an easy band.
No live learner history or live inventory queries. Captured inventory basis and synthetic selection limitations are explicit.
Controlled bank-only tests do not exhaust all conceivable human strategies. Mathematically verifying a candidate by substitution/differentiation is valid work, not an incidental cue.

claims.fidelity: 10 complete source banks replayed, 50 choices preserved
claims.correctness: Independent visible-math differential residuals verify keys and reject all distractors in the tested records
claims.grading: Actual native learner grader exercised for each authored choice; final exact cases included
claims.decision_variation: All five formula roles exercised in every recognizable source profile and survive delivery; not inferred from aggregate answer balance
claims.rendering: Seven actual UI previews inspected; long displays corrected and final images checked
